title: Personal SLA Breach Count by Signal
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalsla:status
| search breach_count=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(breach_count) as breach_count by _time signal_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks personal SLA breaches over time and breaks it out by signal.
value: Breach count by signal shows which promise to yourself is failing most often.
implementation: Send personal SLA breaches events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of personal SLA breaches by signal.
grandmaExplanation: It records how personal SLA breaches changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
